A2A_AGENT_NAME.description: Name advertised on this agent's Agent Card (default: hostname-derived).

A2A_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any authenticated A2A peer to reach the agent (dev only).

A2A_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Task/context id used as the cron / notification delivery target for deliver=a2a.

A2A_HOST.description: Inbound bind host. Defaults to 127.0.0.1; only widens to 0.0.0.0 when a bearer token is set AND you opt in here.

AGENT_BROWSER_ENGINE.description: Local browser engine: auto (default Chrome), lightpanda (faster, no screenshots; Browser Use mode spawns lightpanda serve), chrome

AI_GATEWAY_BASE_URL.description: Vercel AI Gateway base URL override

ALIBABA_CODING_PLAN_BASE_URL.description: Alibaba Cloud (Coding Plan) base URL override

ALIBABA_CODING_PLAN_CN_BASE_URL.description: Alibaba Cloud (Coding Plan, China) base URL override

API_SERVER_ENABLED.description: Enable the OpenAI-compatible API server (true/false). Allows frontends like Open WebUI, LobeChat, etc. to connect.

API_SERVER_HOST.description: Host/bind address for the API server (default: 127.0.0.1). API_SERVER_KEY is still required even on loopback binds.

API_SERVER_KEY.description: Bearer token for API server authentication. Required whenever the API server is enabled; server refuses to start without it.

API_SERVER_MODEL_NAME.description: Model name advertised on /v1/models. Defaults to the profile name (or 'hermes-agent' for the default profile). Useful for multi-user setups with OpenWebUI.

AWS_PROFILE.description: AWS named profile for Bedrock authentication (from ~/.aws/credentials)

AWS_REGION.description: AWS region for Bedrock API calls (e.g. us-east-1, eu-central-1)

AZURE_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL.description: Azure Foundry base URL (set via 'hermes model' for endpoint-specific config)

BLUEBUBBLES_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated iMessage addresses (email or phone) allowed to use the bot

BLUEBUBBLES_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow all BlueBubbles users without allowlist

BLUEBUBBLES_SERVER_URL.description: BlueBubbles server URL for iMessage integration (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:1234)

BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID.description: Browserbase project ID (optional — only needed for cloud browser)

BUZZ_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated npubs or hex pubkeys allowed to talk to the agent

BUZZ_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any community member to talk to the agent (true/false)

BUZZ_AUTH_TAG.description: Optional NIP-OA owner-attestation auth tag JSON for NIP-42 WebSocket auth

BUZZ_CHANNELS.description: Comma-separated channel UUIDs to watch (default: all joined channels)

BUZZ_CLI_PATH.description: Path to the buzz CLI binary (default: 'buzz' on PATH, then ~/bin/buzz)

BUZZ_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Channel UUID for cron / notification delivery (defaults to the first watched channel)

BUZZ_RELAY_URL.description: Base URL of the Buzz community relay (e.g. https://mycommunity.communities.buzz.xyz)

BUZZ_REPLY_IN_THREAD.description: Thread replies under the triggering message (true/false, default: true); false posts flat to the channel timeline

BUZZ_TRANSPORT.description: Inbound transport: auto (WebSocket w/ poll fallback, default), websocket, or poll

CAMOFOX_URL.description: Camofox browser server URL for local anti-detection browsing (e.g. http://localhost:9377)

CONNECTOR_GATEWAY_URL.description: Exact connector-gateway origin for the connectors API (optional)

DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL.description: Custom DashScope base URL (default: coding-intl OpenAI-compat endpoint)

DASHSCOPE_CN_BASE_URL.description: Alibaba Cloud DashScope (China) base URL override

DINGTALK_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated staff/sender IDs allowed to talk to the bot (* = any)

DINGTALK_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default conversation ID for cron / notification delivery

DINGTALK_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Display name for the DingTalk home channel

DINGTALK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Static robot webhook URL for cross-platform / cron delivery

DISCORD_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated Discord user IDs allowed to use the bot

DISCORD_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any Discord user to trigger the bot (dev only)

DISCORD_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default channel ID for cron / notification delivery

DISCORD_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Display name for the Discord home channel

DISCORD_REPLY_TO_MODE.description: Discord reply threading mode: 'off' (no reply references), 'first' (reply on first message only, default), 'all' (reply on every chunk)

EMAIL_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated email addresses allowed to talk to the bot

EMAIL_AUTHSERV_ID.description: Exact authserv-id on your mail server's topmost Authentication-Results header, e.g. mx.google.com (required unless EMAIL_TRUST_FROM_HEADER=true)

EMAIL_HOME_ADDRESS.description: Default address for cron / notification delivery

EMAIL_IMAP_HOST.description: IMAP host for inbound polling (e.g. imap.gmail.com)

FAL_KEY.description: FAL API key for image and video generation

FEISHU_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated Feishu user IDs allowed to talk to the bot

FEISHU_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any Feishu user to trigger the bot (dev only)

FEISHU_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default chat ID for cron / notification delivery

FEISHU_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Display name for the Feishu home channel

FIRECRAWL_API_URL.description: Firecrawl API URL for self-hosted instances (optional)

FIRECRAWL_BROWSER_TTL.description: Firecrawl browser session TTL in seconds (optional, default 300)

FIRECRAWL_GATEWAY_URL.description: Exact Firecrawl tool-gateway origin override for Nous Subscribers only (optional)

GATEWAY_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow all users to interact with messaging bots (true/false). Default: false.

GATEWAY_PROXY_KEY.description: Bearer token for authenticating with the remote Hermes API server (proxy mode). Must match the API_SERVER_KEY on the remote host.

GATEWAY_PROXY_URL.description: URL of a remote Hermes API server to forward messages to (proxy mode). When set, the gateway handles platform I/O only — all agent work is delegated to the remote server. Use for Docker E2EE containers that relay to a host agent. Also configurable via gateway.proxy_url in config.yaml.

GEMINI_BASE_URL.description: Google AI Studio base URL override

GOOGLE_CHAT_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated user emails allowed to interact with the bot.

GOOGLE_CHAT_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default space for cron / notification delivery (e.g. spaces/AAAA...).

GOOGLE_CHAT_HTTP_EVENTS_AUDIENCE.description: Expected audience for Google-signed HTTP event bearer tokens. Defaults to GOOGLE_CHAT_HTTP_EVENTS_URL.

GOOGLE_CHAT_HTTP_EVENTS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_.description: Expected Google service account email for HTTP event bearer tokens.

GOOGLE_CHAT_HTTP_EVENTS_URL.description: Authenticated HTTP endpoint for Chat message events.

GOOGLE_CHAT_PROJECT_ID.description: GCP project ID for optional Pub/Sub inbound mode. Falls back to GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT.

GOOGLE_CHAT_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.description: Path to Service Account JSON key (or inline JSON). Leave empty to use Application Default Credentials on Cloud Run / GCE. Falls back to GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.

GOOGLE_CHAT_SUBSCRIPTION_NAME.description: Optional Pub/Sub subscription path for pull-mode inbound events.

HERMES_EPHEMERAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT.description: Ephemeral system prompt injected at API-call time (never persisted to sessions)

HERMES_PREFILL_MESSAGES_FILE.description: Path to JSON file with ephemeral prefill messages for few-shot priming

HERMES_QWEN_BASE_URL.description: Qwen Portal base URL override (default: https://portal.qwen.ai/v1)

HERMES_SIMPLEX_TEXT_BATCH_DELAY.description: Quiet-period seconds (default: 0.8) used to concatenate rapid-fire inbound text messages into a single MessageEvent — same pattern as Telegram's text batching.

HF_BASE_URL.description: Hugging Face Inference Providers base URL override

HINDSIGHT_API_URL.description: Base URL for the Hindsight API (default: https://api.hindsight.vectorize.io)

HONCHO_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for self-hosted Honcho instances (no API key needed)

IRC_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated IRC nicks allowed to talk to the bot

IRC_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow anyone in the channel to talk to the bot (dev only)

IRC_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Channel for cron / notification delivery (defaults to IRC_CHANNEL)

IRC_PORT.description: IRC server port (default: 6697 with TLS, 6667 without)

IRC_USE_TLS.description: Use TLS for the IRC connection (1/true/yes to enable, default: true on port 6697)

LINE_ALLOWED_GROUPS.description: Comma-separated LINE group IDs the bot will respond in (C-prefixed)

LINE_ALLOWED_ROOMS.description: Comma-separated LINE room IDs the bot will respond in (R-prefixed)

LINE_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated LINE user IDs allowed to DM the bot (U-prefixed)

LINE_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any LINE user to talk to the bot (dev only — disables allowlist)

LINE_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default user/group/room ID for cron / notification delivery

LINE_HOST.description: Webhook bind host (default: unset → dual-stack, all interfaces IPv4+IPv6)

LINE_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public HTTPS base URL for serving images/audio/video to LINE (e.g. https://my-tunnel.example.com). Required for media sending when the bind address is not directly reachable.

LINE_SLOW_RESPONSE_THRESHOLD.description: Seconds before the slow-LLM postback button fires (default: 45; set 0 to disable and always Push-fallback)

MATRIX_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated Matrix user IDs allowed to use the bot (@user:server format)

MATRIX_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any Matrix user to trigger the bot (dev only)

MATRIX_AUTO_THREAD.description: Auto-create threads for messages in Matrix rooms (default: true)

MATRIX_DEVICE_ID.description: Stable Matrix device ID for E2EE persistence across restarts (e.g. HERMES_BOT)

MATRIX_DM_AUTO_THREAD.description: Auto-create threads for DM messages in Matrix (default: false)

MATRIX_FREE_RESPONSE_ROOMS.description: Comma-separated Matrix room IDs where bot responds without @mention

MATRIX_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default room ID for cron / notification delivery

MATRIX_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Display name for the Matrix home room

MATRIX_RECOVERY_KEY.description: Matrix recovery key for cross-signing verification after device key rotation (from Element: Settings → Security → Recovery Key)

MATRIX_REQUIRE_MENTION.description: Require @mention in Matrix rooms (default: true). Set to false to respond to all messages.

MATTERMOST_ALLOWED_CHANNELS.description: If set, the bot only responds in these channels (whitelist).

MATTERMOST_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated Mattermost user IDs allowed to use the bot

MATTERMOST_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any Mattermost user to trigger the bot (dev only)

MATTERMOST_FREE_RESPONSE_CHANNELS.description: Comma-separated Mattermost channel IDs where bot responds without @mention

MATTERMOST_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default channel ID for cron / notification delivery

MATTERMOST_REPLY_MODE.description: How replies are sent: 'thread' (nested) or 'off' (flat). Default: off.

MATTERMOST_REQUIRE_MENTION.description: Require @mention in Mattermost channels (default: true). Set to false to respond to all messages.

META_BASE_URL.description: Meta Model API base URL override

NEBIUS_BASE_URL.description: Nebius Token Factory base URL override

NTFY_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any topic to talk to the bot (dev only — disables allowlist)

NTFY_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default topic for cron / notification delivery

NTFY_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Human label for the home channel (defaults to the topic name)

NTFY_MARKDOWN.description: Send replies with X-Markdown: true header (true/false, default: false)

NTFY_PUBLISH_TOPIC.description: Topic to publish replies to (defaults to NTFY_TOPIC)

NTFY_TOPIC.description: Topic name to subscribe to (e.g. hermes-in)

NVIDIA_BASE_URL.description: NVIDIA NIM base URL override (e.g. http://localhost:8000/v1 for local NIM)

OLLAMA_BASE_URL.description: Ollama Cloud base URL override (default: https://ollama.com/v1)

PHOTON_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated E.164 phone numbers allowed to talk to the bot

PHOTON_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any sender to trigger the bot (dev only — disables allowlist)

PHOTON_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default Photon target for cron / notification delivery: Spectrum space id, DM GUID, or bare E.164 phone number

PHOTON_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Human label for the home channel

PHOTON_MARKDOWN.description: Send agent replies as markdown — iMessage renders it natively, other Spectrum platforms degrade to plain text (true/false, default true)

PHOTON_MENTION_PATTERNS.description: Mention wake-word regexes for group chats (JSON list or comma/newline-separated; defaults to Hermes wake words)

PHOTON_NODE_BIN.description: Path to the node binary (default: PM's pinned node, then PATH)

PHOTON_PROJECT_ID.description: Spectrum project id (the project's spectrumProjectId; set by `hermes photon setup`)

PHOTON_REACTIONS.description: Tapback 👀/👍/👎 on messages as processing status and route tapbacks on bot messages to the agent (true/false, default false)

PHOTON_READ_RECEIPTS.description: Mark inbound iMessages read after forwarding to Hermes (true/false, default true)

PHOTON_REQUIRE_MENTION.description: Ignore group-chat messages unless they match a mention wake word (true/false, default false)

PHOTON_SIDECAR_AUTOSTART.description: Spawn the Node sidecar on connect (true/false, default true)

PHOTON_SIDECAR_PORT.description: Loopback port for the Node sidecar control + inbound channel (default 8789)

PHOTON_TELEMETRY.description: Enable Spectrum SDK telemetry in the sidecar (true/false, default false; toggle with `hermes photon telemetry on|off`)

PORCUPINE_ACCESS_KEY.description: Picovoice access key for the Porcupine 'Hey Hermes' wake word engine (optional; openWakeWord is the free default)

QQBOT_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default QQ channel/group for cron delivery and notifications

QQBOT_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Display name for the QQ home channel

QQ_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated QQ user IDs allowed to use the bot

QQ_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow all QQ users without an allowlist (true/false)

QQ_APP_ID.description: QQ Bot App ID from QQ Open Platform (q.qq.com)

QQ_GROUP_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated QQ group IDs allowed to interact with the bot

QQ_SANDBOX.description: Enable QQ sandbox mode for development testing (true/false)

RAFT_PROFILE.description: Raft agent profile slug — auto-enables the adapter when set

RETAINDB_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for self-hosted RetainDB instances (default: https://api.retaindb.com)

SEARXNG_URL.description: URL of your SearXNG instance for free self-hosted web search

SIMPLEX_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated SimpleX contact IDs allowed to talk to the bot

SIMPLEX_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any contact to talk to the bot (dev only — disables allowlist)

SIMPLEX_GROUP_ALLOWED.description: Comma-separated SimpleX group IDs the bot should participate in, or '*' to allow any group. Omit to ignore group messages entirely (safer default — a bot in a group otherwise processes every member's traffic).

SIMPLEX_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default contact/group ID for cron / notification delivery

SIMPLEX_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Human label for the home channel (defaults to the ID)

SIMPLEX_WS_URL.description: WebSocket URL of the simplex-chat daemon (e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:5225)

SLACK_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated Slack member IDs allowed to use Hermes, e.g. U01ABC2DEF3. Without this, Slack may connect but deny messages by default.

SLACK_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any Slack user to trigger the bot (dev only)

SLACK_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default channel ID for cron / notification delivery (starts with C)

SLACK_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Display name for the Slack home channel

SLACK_THREAD_REQUIRE_MENTION.description: Require an explicit @mention for Slack thread replies while preserving top-level free response channels

SMS_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated phone numbers allowed to talk to the bot

SMS_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default phone number for cron / notification delivery

STEPFUN_BASE_URL.description: StepFun Step Plan base URL override

TEAMS_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated Teams user IDs / UPNs allowed to talk to the bot

TEAMS_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any Teams user to trigger the bot (dev only)

TEAMS_CLIENT_ID.description: Azure AD application (Bot Framework) client ID

TEAMS_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default chat/channel ID for cron / notification delivery

TEAMS_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Display name for the Teams home channel

TEAMS_HOST.description: Webhook bind host (default: unset → dual-stack, all interfaces IPv4+IPv6)

TEAMS_INCOMING_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Incoming-webhook URL for meeting-summary delivery in webhook mode (the URL is the credential)

TEAMS_REQUIRE_MENTION.description: Only answer channel/group-chat messages that @mention the bot or reply to it (default false; needed once the app has RSC message-read consent)

TEAMS_TENANT_ID.description: Azure AD tenant ID hosting the bot application

TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Optional comma-separated numeric Telegram user IDs allowed immediately; leave blank to approve new users through DM pairing

TELEGRAM_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any Telegram user to trigger the bot (dev only)

TELEGRAM_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default chat ID for cron / notification delivery

TELEGRAM_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Display name for the Telegram home channel

TELEGRAM_PROXY.description: Proxy URL for Telegram connections (overrides HTTPS_PROXY). Supports http://, https://, socks5://

TOOL_GATEWAY_DOMAIN.description: Shared tool-gateway domain suffix for Nous Subscribers only, used to derive vendor hosts, e.g. nousresearch.com -> firecrawl-gateway.nousresearch.com

TOOL_GATEWAY_SCHEME.description: Shared tool-gateway URL scheme for Nous Subscribers only, used to derive vendor hosts (`https` by default, set `http` for local gateway testing)

TOOL_GATEWAY_URL.description: Exact shared tool-gateway origin for on-origin vendors and media uploads (optional)

VOICE_TOOLS_OPENAI_KEY.description: OpenAI API key for voice transcription (Whisper) and OpenAI TTS

WEBHOOK_ENABLED.description: Enable the webhook platform adapter for receiving events from GitHub, GitLab, etc.

WEBHOOK_PORT.description: Port for the webhook HTTP server (default: 8644).

WECOM_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated WeCom user IDs allowed to talk to the bot

WECOM_CALLBACK_ENCODING_AES_KEY.description: WeCom callback EncodingAESKey for message crypto

WECOM_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default chat ID for cron / notification delivery

WHATSAPP_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated WhatsApp user IDs allowed to talk to the bot

WHATSAPP_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any WhatsApp user to trigger the bot (dev only)

WHATSAPP_ENABLED.description: Enable the WhatsApp adapter (requires the Node.js bridge running)

WHATSAPP_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default chat ID for cron / notification delivery

WHATSAPP_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Display name for the WhatsApp home channel

XIAOMI_BASE_URL.description: Xiaomi MiMo base URL override (default: https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1)
